1 52.346 37.714 Non-Solicitation: I will not, for a period of one year after the Separation Date, solicit, interfere with, or cause
1 52.346 50.714 any current Red Cross employee to leave employment with the Red Cross, nor will I solicit, induce, or attempt
1 52.346 63.714 to induce any of the Red Cross’ past or current customers, clients, or donors (a) to cease doing business, in
1 52.346 76.714 whole or in part, with or through the Red Cross, or (b) to do business with any other person, corporation, or
1 52.346 89.714 other entity performing services materially similar to or competitive with those provided by the Red Cross.

1 52.346 217.714 Claims includes, but is not limited to, the following:
1 - 242.714 (a)

1 76.346 293.714 dealing, interference with contractual relations, interference with prospective economic advantage,

1 - 344.714 (c)

1 76.346 357.714 in Employment Act of 1967 (“ADEA”), the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, the
1 76.346 370.714 Americans with Disabilities Act, the Civil Rights Act of 1991, the civil rights statutes codified at 42
1 76.346 383.714 U.S.C.§ 1981 et seq., the Family and Medical Leave Act, and any other applicable federal, state or local
1 76.346 396.714 statute, law, ordinance, decision, rule or law of any kind, as well as any amendments thereof; provided,
1 76.346 409.714 however, that the following claims are excluded from this provision and are NOT waived:

1 - 535.714 (d)

1 76.346 548.714 Agreement, notwithstanding the provisions of Section 1542 of the Civil Code of California, and in spite

1 28.346 599.714 11
1 52.346 599.714 No Lawsuits or Other Actions: I have not filed or caused to be filed any lawsuits, charges or complaints
1 52.346 612.714 against the Red Cross with any court or municipal, state or federal agency. To the extent consistent with
1 52.346 625.714 applicable law, I will not initiate any legal action, charge or complaint against the Red Cross in any forum in
1 52.346 638.714 connection with the claims released in this Agreement, except that I understand that nothing in this Agreement
1 52.346 651.714 interferes with my right to file a charge with the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (“EEOC”)
1 52.346 664.714 or participate in an EEOC investigation or proceeding. I understand that I am waiving the right to recover
1 52.346 677.714 monetary or other damages in any action brought by the EEOC or any other party.

2 52.346 369.714 Cooperation in Legal Proceedings: I will cooperate with the Red Cross in any investigations into matters
2 52.346 382.714 that occurred during my employment. If I have knowledge relevant to any legal proceeding in which the
2 52.346 395.714 Red Cross is involved, I agree to be available at mutually agreed-upon times and places to assist the Red
2 52.346 408.714 Cross or its agents in the legal proceeding. If I am contacted by anyone concerning a potential claim, charge,
2 52.346 421.714 complaint, demand, lawsuit, governmental investigation or other proceeding against the Red Cross, or if I
2 52.346 434.714 receive a subpoena concerning a proceeding against it, I will notify the Red Cross’ Office of General Counsel
2 52.346 447.714 as soon as possible at 431 18th Street, NW, Washington, DC 20006, Phone: (202) 303-5433; Fax: (202)
2 52.346 460.714 303-0143.
2 28.346 485.714 14
2 52.346 485.714 Liquidated Damages: In the event I violate this Agreement after accepting any of its benefits, the Red Cross
2 52.346 498.714 shall be entitled to liquidated damages in the amount of $5,000. I acknowledge that the actual damages the
2 52.346 511.714 Red Cross would sustain upon any such violation are difficult or impossible to ascertain in advance and that
2 52.346 524.714 the sum of $5,000 is a reasonable approximation of a likely amount of damages.
2 28.346 549.714 15
2 52.346 549.714 Severability: If any term of this Agreement is held to be illegal, invalid, or unenforceable, all other provisions
2 52.346 562.714 will remain in full force and effect. The illegal, invalid, or unenforceable provision will, to the extent
2 52.346 575.714 permissible, be applied so as to render the remaining provisions enforceable.

2 28.346 638.714 17

2 52.346 651.714 supersedes any and all prior negotiations, agreements and understandings between us about the matters in
2 52.346 664.714 the Agreement, except that my commitments contained in the Code of Business Ethics and Conduct and any
2 52.346 677.714 prior executed confidentiality agreements, including the Confidential Information and Intellectual Property
2 52.346 690.714 Agreement, remain in effect. This Agreement may only be modified in a written amendment signed both by
2 52.346 703.714 me and by a duly authorized officer of the Red Cross. In entering into this Agreement, I have relied only on its
2 52.346 716.714 written terms and not on any statements or representations of any person or entity.
